messages:
alex: Heads-up: Snyk flagged pyyaml 6.0 in our builder image with a deserialization issue (CVE-2025-12345). This shows up during the docker build step for the packaging job and is currently failing the gated release. Can we get a temporary allowance to proceed with today's roll while we patch?

sam: +1 on details — is pyyaml actually included in the final runtime image or only in the build image?

alex: Only in the build container used by CI to generate distro tarballs and run some packaging utils. It's pulled via requirements-dev.txt during the build. Not present in the app runtime image.

alex: Repro + scan excerpt: <https://scans.redwood.dev/reports/78934|snyk report>

alex: Dockerfile snippet:
```
FROM python:3.11-slim as builder
COPY requirements-dev.txt ./
RUN pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
# packaging steps that use pyyaml for metadata parsing
```

maya: Thanks. Two quick asks before I can approve a temporary exception: (1) mitigation plan for exploitability during the window, (2) exact expiry date for the allowlist and tracking issue/PR.

sam: Mitigations: run builder in a dedicated k8s namespace with no external access, use immutable build nodes, and ensure the build user has no credentials mounted. We can also switch the packaging job to use a pinned, vendorized copy of the specific scripts that need pyyaml.

jordan: Also add runtime detection: ingest build logs into our audit pipeline and alert on any unexpected runtime inclusion of pyyaml in images. Quick grep in the image manifest should catch accidental promotions.

security-bot: Automated scan: pyyaml 6.0 -> CVE-2025-12345 (Medium, 6.1). Exploitability: requires crafted YAML & code path that uses unsafe_load. Affected only if unsafe_load is used. See: <https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2025-12345|CVE link>.

ops-oncall: If we allow a temporary exception, SRE wants an explicit runbook in case build compromise is suspected. Add steps to revoke artifacts and block deploys.

alex: I've opened GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/issues/456 — contains proposed PR that: (a) pins pyyaml to a patched fork in the builder image, (b) adds a follow-up PR to remove and upgrade to patched pyyaml in 7 days, (c) adds audit log ingestion.

alex: Proposed expiry: 2026-04-03 (7 days). Will also add a CI gate that fails if pyyaml ends up in final image.

maya: Sounds reasonable. Conditions for approval: 1) builder runs in isolated namespace, 2) GH issue + PR opened and linked, 3) runbook added to the issue, 4) expiry <= 7 days and auto-escalation to sec-oncall if not remediated. If all met, temporary allowlist approved until 2026-04-03.

jordan: I'll add the CI grep job and an alert to pagerduty if pyyaml appears in runtime images.

sam: I'll update the deployment YAML to ensure build pods have no serviceaccount tokens and no cloud creds.

alex: Thanks all — implementing now. Will post PR numbers and schedule the patch. :thumbsup:

maya: Approved (conditional) :white_check_mark: — please follow the checklist in the issue and ping if anything changes.

alex: Will do. Creating the allowlist entry in the security tracker and tagging it as "temporary-build-only".

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Will watch the alert rules for the next week.

alex: Closing loop here once PR is merged. Thanks!
